choose.when: disposition_status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING') AND ingest_status IN ('RETRY_PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED','FAILED') AND ciphertext_deleted_at IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT LOWER(HEX(receipt_id)) receipt_id, ingest_status status,body_processing_status body_status,contact_processing_status contact_status,urgency_class urgency, retry_count,disposition_status,disposition_reason,disposition_note,disposition_at,last_error_code error_code, retention_until,next_retry_at,received_at, CASE WHEN retention_until>NOW(3) AND ciphertext_deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(last_error_code,'') NOT IN ('AEADBadTagException','IllegalBlockSizeException','InvalidKeyException') THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END retryable, CASE WHEN retention_until<=NOW(3) OR ciphertext_deleted_at IS NOT NULL THEN '原始密文已过期或清理，需由客户端重新提交' WHEN COALESCE(last_error_code,'') IN ('AEADBadTagException','IllegalBlockSizeException','InvalidKeyException') THEN '密文或密钥不兼容，重复处理无法恢复，需由客户端重新提交' ELSE '可重新提交至安全处理器' END action_hint FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE ORDER BY urgency_class DESC,received_at LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_sdk_ingest SET ingest_status='RECEIVED',disposition_status='RETRYING', body_processing_status='PENDING',retry_count=0,next_retry_at=NOW(3),last_error_code=NULL,last_error_detail=NULL,processed_at=NULL WHERE receipt_id=#{receipt} AND ingest_status IN ('RETRY_PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED','FAILED') AND retention_until>NOW(3) AND ciphertext_deleted_at IS NULL AND COALESCE(last_error_code,'') NOT IN ('AEADBadTagException','IllegalBlockSizeException','InvalidKeyException')

UPDATE t_sdk_ingest SET disposition_status='CLOSED',disposition_reason=#{reason},disposition_note=#{note}, disposition_by=#{actor},disposition_at=NOW(3) WHERE receipt_id=#{receipt} AND disposition_status IN ('OPEN','RETRYING') AND ingest_status IN ('RETRY_PENDING','REVIEW_NEEDED','FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT encrypted_data_key,payload_ciphertext, payload_nonce,payload_tag FROM t_sdk_ingest WHERE receipt_id=#{receipt} AND ingest_status IN ('REVIEW_NEEDED','FAILED') AND retention_until>NOW(3) AND ciphertext_deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1
